answer: Defense by upkeep proof: each agent must, at unpredictable moments, sign an artifact derived from a freshly drawn juniper seed and publish it before the next ridge checkpoint closes. Weight survives only while the streak is unbroken; stake behind a lapsed identity is slashed into the pool that pays the auditors. A sybil farm cannot forge the streak cheaply, since each puppet needs its own live process, its own key and a seed-valid answer, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand always-on workers plus a thousand stakes at risk. One shared backend shows identical latency and is clustered out.
